notes:
SaaS KB/RAG buyer focused on embeddings + reranking. High QPS target (600-900 qps sustained) for multi-tenant hosted offering; currently ~650k docs (~1.8M passages). Wants sub-150ms median end-to-end for simple queries with reranker tail SLO <220ms. Strong cost sensitivity: target < $0.002/query average across retrieval+rerank. Interested in Redwood hosted API if we can demonstrate predictable unit economics and routing/fallback that keeps user experience consistent under burst. Quote from CTO: "We need the reranker but it mustn't double our per-query bill. If batching + prefix cache can cut ops by 30% that's compelling." Technical preference: ANN retrieval (HNSW/IVF) + lightweight reranker (distilled LLM) on top; open-embedding models vs commercial embeddings being A/B'd. Security: SOC2 required, SSO + SCIM for provisioning, per-tenant audit logs and optional EU residency for select customers. POC scope agreed: ingest sample KB, run 2-week load profile, measure median/p95 latencies and cost per 1k queries under different routing rules. 
Shorthand: 
- demo looked good, AE + SE alignment strong. 
- finance worried about burst pricing; want committed capex for predictable pricing. 
- security sent questionnaire (see drive).

use_case_summary: Customer-facing KB search for SaaS help center + in-app support assistant. Retrieval pipeline: candidate generation via embeddings (ANN) -> reranker to improve precision for short queries. Primary goals: keep latency low at high QPS, control cost per query, and enable gradual model upgrades with deterministic routing. Wants hosted API for speed-to-production and Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching/quantization recommendations.
